policy: Variants are prompt guidance and provisional risk indicators, never automatic semantic approval or a replacement for structural validators.

sources.scope: Official Arabic curriculum usage for arithmetic and circle/radius/diameter terminology; indexed text inspected. Direct PDF fetch timed out. Not an exhaustive bilingual standard.
Official examples distinguishing addition, subtraction and difference; indexed text inspected.
Circle-intersection mathematics, not Arabic translation authority. Source errors must remain separate from translation fidelity.

terms.note: Subtracting as an initial fragment may be بطرح. الاستثناء denotes exclusion/exception, not the subtraction operation.
Choose the grammatical form from the complete source sentence.
Preserve the operation; never carry it out in the fragment.
Dividing by and dividing into require direction-sensitive human review.
Translate squaring literally even if the source applies it incorrectly.
This longer term takes precedence over square at the same source position.
A sum is distinct from a product or difference.
Direction and absolute difference may depend on the source context.
A circle, disk, sphere and rotation are distinct concepts. Inflection is context dependent.
Accept appropriate singular, dual and plural forms; do not confuse radius with diameter.
Diameter must not silently become radius.
Possessive agreement and dual forms require context.
Do not repair an incomplete source intersection criterion while translating.
Regional terminology varies. Preserve brackets, endpoints and open/closed status in source-owned literals.
Both comparison direction and inclusion of equality matter.
Do not remove the equality alternative.
A strict relation must not acquire equality.
A strict relation must not acquire equality.

terms.accepted: اذا وفقط اذا|حين وفقط حين|شرط لازم وكاف
terms.note: An ordinary if is not equivalent to if and only if.
Do not upgrade a one-way condition to equivalence.
A one-word fragment needs sentence context; prefix agreement is reviewed by a human.
Inclusive/exclusive meaning must follow the source, not be inferred.
Endpoint inclusion is not supplied when the English source leaves it unspecified.
Number-system base and geometric base differ; use the problem context.
Distinguish digits from complete numbers.
